simple.meaning: חֲקוּפָא (Chăqûwphâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Chakupha , one of the Nethinim.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֲקוּפָא (H2709) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 2:51, with occurrences in Ezra, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲקוּפָא (H2709) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֲקוּפָא (H2709) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֲקוּפָא (Chăqûwphâʼ) / H2709 is traced through Ezra 2:51, Nehemiah 7:53 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H2709. Chaqupha חֲקוּפָא proper name, masculine head of a family of returning exiles Ezra 2:51 = Neh 7:53 , ᵐ5 Αφεικα , Αχειφα , Ακουφα , etc.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root probably meaning to bend; crooked;
